› Explain in three sentences what a mutex is. Do not use any tools.


• A mutex is a synchronization mechanism that allows only one thread or process to access a shared resource at a time. A
  worker locks the mutex before using the resource and unlocks it afterward. This prevents race conditions and
  inconsistent data.
